notes: An unrecognised toolName. The Copilot branch is default-deny for unknown names; because Copilot discards stdout and stderr on exit 2, the deny is emitted as JSON at exit 0, which is itself fail-closed on that provider. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
